empty.needFullRecords: Need at least 2 days with both inbound and attendance for comparison; attendance-only and missing-attendance days are excluded from best/worst analysis
empty.needTwoDates: Select at least 2 different dates for comparison

missing.personnel: Some dates lack personnel attendance data; front-desk hours factor not included.
missing.scanner: Some dates lack scanner data; personal efficiency factor not included.

rootCause.normalizedGapMasked: Cainiao mix masked {{amount}} parcels/h of operational issues
rootCause.normalizedGapMinor: Cainiao mix has minor impact on the gap

hours.footnote: Front-desk hours don't produce scan volume; higher share drags total efficiency. "Output per sorter hour" = volume ÷ sorter hours — effective output density.

scanner.footnoteDelta: Delta = best-day efficiency − worst-day efficiency; larger positive values mean a bigger drop on the worst day. Sorted accordingly.
scanner.footnoteAbsentDesc: means the sorter did not work that day.

personnel.footnote: Headers show daily volume and Cainiao share; cells show hours, scan efficiency (if any), and role.

ai.title: AI deep analysis
ai.subtitle: Combined view of staffing, scan efficiency, and hours structure
ai.failed: AI analysis failed — try again later.
ai.placeholder: Click "Start analysis" for AI diagnosis using personnel detail, scanner performance, and hours structure across all dates.

detail.cainiaoHigherOnWorst: Worst day Cainiao share {{worstPct}}%, higher than best day {{bestPct}}%. Cainiao parcels process faster, giving worst day a {{worstBonus}} parcels/h structural boost (best day only {{bestBonus}} parcels/h), partially offsetting the gap but masking larger operational issues.
detail.cainiaoLowerOnWorst: Worst day Cainiao share {{worstPct}}%, lower than best day {{bestPct}}%. Lower Cainiao share naturally lowers efficiency, widening the gap.
detail.cainiaoSimilar: Similar Cainiao share on both days ({{pct}}%); Cainiao mix contributes little to the gap.
detail.frontDesk: Worst day front-desk share {{worstPct}}%, best day {{bestPct}}% (front desk doesn't produce scan volume; higher share lowers total efficiency)
detail.volumeWithBest: Best day volume {{bestVolume}} parcels, worst day {{worstVolume}} parcels ({{diffPct}}% gap). Low volume with fixed staffing dilutes efficiency.
detail.volumeSimple: Volume: best day {{bestVolume}} parcels, worst day {{worstVolume}} parcels
detail.hoursPerPerson: Best day avg hours {{bestHpp}}h, worst day {{worstHpp}}h (longer hours without added output suggests excess on-site time on low-volume days)
detail.scanner: Best day sorter composite efficiency {{bestEff}} parcels/h, worst day {{worstEff}} parcels/h (personal efficiency after Cainiao correction)
detail.scannerMissing: Some dates lack sorter scan data; personal efficiency contribution unavailable
detail.residual: After quantifiable structural factors, ~{{residualAbs}} parcels/h of the gap remains unexplained — possibly staffing state, equipment issues, or process disruption. Pure operational gap (Cainiao stripped): {{pureBest}} vs {{pureWorst}} = {{normalizedGap}} parcels/h.

suggestion.volumeReduceStaff: Worst day volume only {{worstVolume}} parcels (best day {{bestVolume}}); consider reducing sorters by ~{{reducible}} on low-volume days to avoid wasted hours.
suggestion.volumeInsufficient: Worst day volume only {{worstVolume}} parcels, {{diffPct}}% below best day — insufficient inbound volume is the main driver; investigate arrival fluctuations.
suggestion.frontDesk: Worst day front-desk share {{worstPct}}% ({{worstHours}}h total), well above best day {{bestPct}}%; front desk consumes hours without scan output — trim front-desk shifts on low-volume days.
suggestion.hoursPerPersonLonger: Worst day avg hours {{worstHpp}}h, above best day {{bestHpp}}h — sorters stay on-site too long on low-volume days; adjust shift length to volume.
suggestion.hoursPerPersonShorter: Worst day avg hours {{worstHpp}}h, below best day {{bestHpp}}h — ensure adequate peak staffing to avoid slowing sorting pace.
suggestion.cainiaoLower: Worst day Cainiao share {{worstPct}}%, below best day {{bestPct}}%. Cainiao parcels process faster; lower share pulls overall efficiency down — part of the gap is volume mix.
suggestion.cainiaoHigher: Worst day Cainiao share {{worstPct}}% is higher than best day {{bestPct}}% — the gap is mainly not Cainiao-driven; focus on staffing and front-desk hours.
suggestion.cainiaoStable: Cainiao share varies {{spreadPct}}% across days — modest day-to-day spread; higher Cainiao share naturally boosts efficiency — interpret comparisons with volume mix in mind.
suggestion.scannerGap: Sorter composite efficiency varies {{gap}} parcels/h across days — review low-efficiency day staffing and upskill weaker performers.
suggestion.default: Efficiency gaps are small with factors evenly distributed — accumulate more days to spot patterns.
